original_ai_output.title_zh: CLEEN基金会在伊莫州呼吁有效落实VAPP法
original_ai_output.summary_zh: CLEEN基金会呼吁伊莫州安全机构、司法人员和社区领袖解决阻碍《暴力侵害人身禁止法》（VAPP法）落实的知识缺口。该组织在奥韦里举行两天政策对话，指出一线执法人员和民间团体缺乏对该法律的了解，并计划分发法律文本、评估机构瓶颈、支持设立举报台。与会者还呼吁设立性侵转介中心并解决司法拖延问题。

key_facts.fact: CLEEN基金会呼吁伊莫州利益相关方解决阻碍VAPP法落实的知识缺口
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The CLEEN Foundation, a non-governmental organisation, has urged security agencies, justice actors, and community leaders in Imo to address knowledge gaps hindering the implementation of the Violence Against Persons Prohibition (VAPP) Law.

key_facts.fact: 该组织在奥韦里举行两天州级政策对话
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: made the call in Owerri, on Wednesday, at the opening of a two-day state-level policy dialogue on bridging VAPP Law implementation gaps

key_facts.fact: 基金会将分发VAPP法文本并支持地方政府设立指定举报台
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the foundation will distribute copies of the VAPP Law, assess institutional bottlenecks, and support local government actors to establish designated reporting desks

key_facts.fact: 该项目由挪威外交部通过挪威大使馆资助，在13个重点州实施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: funded by the Norwegian Ministry of Foreign Affairs through the Norwegian Embassy, was currently being implemented across 13 focal states

key_facts.fact: 州GBV协调员表示部分强奸案件拖延超过五年
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: some rape cases lingered for over five years, in spite of the law stipulating resolution within three months

uncertainties: 报道仅基于单一来源（尼日利亚通讯社），尚缺乏交叉验证
VAPP法在伊莫州的实际执行效果尚未获独立确认
